Rashi on Ketubot 50a:10:1.english: One who brings his son - To study Torah.

Rashi on Ketubot 50a:10:2.english: Runs after him - To nourish him and keep him alive.

Rashi on Ketubot 50a:10:3.english: And does not reach him - He is in danger of dying from his extreme weakness.

Rashi on Ketubot 50a:10:4.english: His friends run after him - to be sharp in Torah like him.

Rashi on Ketubot 50a:10:5.hebrew: הא דכחיש - אל יכניסנו, שמסוכן הוא פן יחליש וימות:
Rashi on Ketubot 50a:10:5.english: This [refers to one] who is weak - He should not bring him [to school], for he is in danger lest he weaken and die.

Rashi on Ketubot 50a:10:6.english: [One] who is healthy - He should bring him [to school], because he becomes sharp.

Rashi on Ketubot 50a:11:1.english: Who sold of [her] melog [usufruct] property - [That is, she sold] the principal.

Rashi on Ketubot 50a:11:2.hebrew: הבעל מוציא - דשויוהו רבנן כלוקח, והוא לוקח ראשון:
Rashi on Ketubot 50a:11:2.english: The husband repossesses - For the Rabbis treated him as a purchaser, and he is the first purchaser.

Rashi on Ketubot 50a:11:3.english: In the crowd - A gathering of people.

Rashi on Ketubot 50a:11:4.hebrew: תנא מיניה - דר' יוסי בר חנינא מרה הוא:
Rashi on Ketubot 50a:11:4.english: He learned from him - That Rabbi Yosei bar Chanina is its master [i.e., the author of this teaching].

Rashi on Ketubot 50a:12:1.hebrew: זה הזן בניו ובנותיו קטנים - שתמיד יום ולילה הן עליו, והיא צדקה שאינו חיוב עליו בהם:
Rashi on Ketubot 50a:12:1.english: This is one who sustains his sons and daughters [when they are] minors - For they are always [dependent] upon him day and night, and it is charity, since there is no obligation upon him regarding them.

Rashi on Ketubot 50a:13:1.hebrew: הון ועושר בביתו - שאין הממון כלה, ואעפ"כ צדקתו עומדת לעד:
Rashi on Ketubot 50a:13:1.english: Wealth and riches are in his house - For the money does not run out, and even so, his charity endures forever.

Rashi on Ketubot 50a:13:2.hebrew: זה הלומד תורה ומלמדה - מתקיימת בו, הרי "הון ועושר בביתו"; "וצדקתו עומדת לעד", על שטרח ללמד לתלמידים:
Rashi on Ketubot 50a:13:2.english: This [is] one who studies Torah and teaches it - [It] is preserved in him — behold, "wealth and riches are in his house"; [and] "his charity endures forever," because he toiled to teach students.

Rashi on Ketubot 50a:13:3.hebrew: זה הכותב כו' - הספרים קיימים לו שאינם כלים, וצדקתו עומדת לעד:
Rashi on Ketubot 50a:13:3.english: This is one who writes, etc. - The books remain his, for they are not consumed, and his charity endures forever.

Rashi on Ketubot 50a:14:1.english: To quarrel - [Over] who is closer and takes precedence in inheritance.

Rashi on Ketubot 50a:1:1.hebrew: ועשיתינהו - כפיתי אותם בחזקה, ומפני שטרחתי עליו ליכנס לו לפנים משורת הדין, מחבביני:
Rashi on Ketubot 50a:1:1.english: And I forced them - I compelled them by force; and because I troubled myself for him to go beyond the letter of the law on his behalf, he holds me dear.

Rashi on Ketubot 50a:1:2.hebrew: ואי דינא הוא - אין כאן גמילות טובה להחזיק לו טובה, שעל כרחו ישפוט אמת:
Rashi on Ketubot 50a:1:2.english: And if it is the law - There is no bestowal of a favor here to be grateful to him, for perforce [the judge] must judge truthfully.

Rashi on Ketubot 50a:2:1.english: One who dispenses - to the poor.

Rashi on Ketubot 50a:2:2.english: [More] than one-fifth - of his property, so that he will not need [the help of] people.

Rashi on Ketubot 50a:3:1.english: I will surely tithe it [lit. tithe, I will tithe it] - Two tithes are a fifth.

Rashi on Ketubot 50a:4:1.hebrew: והא לא דמי בתרא לקמא - דכי שקלת לקמא, פשו להו ט', וכי הדרת מדלית מעשר דידהו, לאו כי קמא הוא, ואין כאן חומש בשניהם:
Rashi on Ketubot 50a:4:1.english: But the latter [tenth] is not like the first - For when you take the first [tenth], nine [parts] remain; and when you again take a tenth of them, it is not like the first [tenth], and there is not a fifth here in both of them.

Rashi on Ketubot 50a:4:2.hebrew: אעשרנו - מדלא כתיב עשר אעשר לך, הכי קאמר: אעשרנו כראשון, כלומר מעשר שני יהא כראשון:
Rashi on Ketubot 50a:4:2.english: I will tithe it - Since it is not written "I will surely tithe to You" [aser a'aser lakh], this is what [Scripture] is saying: I will tithe it like the first [tenth] — that is to say, the second tenth shall be like the first.

Rashi on Ketubot 50a:5:1.english: These statements - of Rabbi Ile'a regarding the ordinance of Usha.

Rashi on Ketubot 50a:5:2.hebrew: מתמעטות והולכות - מאמוראים: הראשונה, א"ר אילעא אמר ר"ל משום דר"י בר חנינא; השניה, ר' אילעא אמר ר"ל; שלישית, ר' אילעא לחודיה:
Rashi on Ketubot 50a:5:2.english: Continually decrease - In [the number of] Amoraim: the first [teaching] — Rabbi Ile’a said [that] Reish Lakish said in the name of Rabbi Yosei bar Ḥanina; the second — Rabbi Ile’a said [in the name of] Reish Lakish; [the] third — Rabbi Ile’a alone.

Rashi on Ketubot 50a:5:3.hebrew: וסימניך - בסדר ההלכות, ובו תדע סדר מיעוטן:
Rashi on Ketubot 50a:5:3.english: And your mnemonic - [is] regarding the order of the halakhot, and through it you will know the order of their diminishing.

Rashi on Ketubot 50a:5:4.hebrew: קטנים כתבו ובזבזו - בניו ובנותיו כשהן קטנים, כותב נכסיו, המבזבז אל יבזבז. ומעתה לא תחליף באיזו שלשה, ובאיזו שנים, ובאיזו אחד:
Rashi on Ketubot 50a:5:4.english: Minors wrote and dispensed - [Referring to] his sons and daughters when they are minors, one who writes [over] his property, [and] one who dispenses should not dispense [excessively]. And from now on, you will not confuse in which [statement there are] three [Sages], and in which two, and in which one.

Rashi on Ketubot 50a:6:1.hebrew: מגלגל עם בנו - אם מסרב מללמוד, יגלגל עמו בנחת ובדברים רכים:
Rashi on Ketubot 50a:6:1.english: Deals gently with his son - If [his son] refuses to study, he should deal with him calmly and with soft words.

Rashi on Ketubot 50a:6:2.english: He descends with him to his life - To discipline him with a strap and with a lack of bread.

Rashi on Ketubot 50a:6:3.hebrew: רב שמואל בר שילת - מלמד תינוקות היה:
Rashi on Ketubot 50a:6:3.english: Rav Shmuel bar Sheilat - [He] was a teacher of young children.

Rashi on Ketubot 50a:6:4.hebrew: וספי ליה כי תורא - הלעיטהו תורה, כשור שאתה מלעיטו ואובסו מאכל:
Rashi on Ketubot 50a:6:4.english: And stuff him like an ox - Feed him Torah, like an ox that you feed and cram [with] food.

Rashi on Ketubot 50a:8:1.hebrew: לתעניתא מעת לעת - להתענות כל היום, וחינוכא לשעות מקודם לכן שנתיים, כדאמרינן ביומא (דף פב.):
Rashi on Ketubot 50a:8:1.english: To fast for twenty-four hours - To fast the entire day; and training [to fast] for [a few] hours [begins] two years prior to that, as we say in Yoma (82a).

Rashi on Ketubot 50a:8:2.hebrew: ובתינוקת - שהיא ממהרת להביא כח, שאינה מתשת כח בלימוד תורה. ותרתי סרי דקאמר, שנת שתים עשרה גופא קאמר, דאי בת שתים עשרה ויום אחד, דאורייתא היא, שמביאה שתי שערות ובת עונשים, ואין צורך לנו ללמוד ממניקתו של אביי:
Rashi on Ketubot 50a:8:2.english: And for a girl - For she is quick to gain strength, since she does not weaken [her] strength with Torah study. And [when] he says "twelve," he means the twelfth year itself; for if [she is] twelve years and one day old, it is [a] biblical [obligation], as she brings forth two [pubic] hairs and is subject to punishments, and we have no need to learn [it] from Abaye's wet-nurse.

Rashi on Ketubot 50a:9:1.english: He will not live - Unless [treated] with a proven remedy.

Rashi on Ketubot 50a:9:2.english: The bile of a vulture - The bile of a vulture [dayah], which is called vostor [in Old French].

Rashi on Ketubot 50a:9:3.english: One should rub him and make him drink - You should rub him with it and give him to drink from it in beer.

Rashi on Ketubot 50a:9:4.hebrew: אצותא דדיקלא - סיב שגדל סביב דקל תומר, כעין וויילד"ה שכורך את עץ הגפן:
Rashi on Ketubot 50a:9:4.english: Palm-tree fiber - A fiber that grows around a date palm, like a tendril [Old French: veille] that winds around a grapevine.

Tosafot on Ketubot 50a:11:1.hebrew: הבעל מוציא מיד הלקוחות - אליבא דר"י דאמר קנין פירות כקנין הגוף דמי, לא צריכא לתקנת אושא, אלא לריש לקיש; ואליבא דריש לקיש מסיק לה בפ' החובל (ב"ק ד' פח: ושם). אי נמי, לר"י נמי אצטריך, כגון נותן מתנה לאשתו שקנתה ואין הבעל אוכל פירות, א"נ דכתב לה: "דין ודברים אין לי בפירות נכסייך". אבל אין לומר דכתב לה: "דין ודברים אין לי בנכסייך ובפירותיהם", דהא תנן בפרק הכותב (לקמן כתובות דף פג.) דאם מכרה ונתנה קיים:
Tosafot on Ketubot 50a:11:1.english: The husband repossesses [it] from the purchasers - According to Rabbi Yoḥanan, who says [that] ownership of the produce is like ownership of the principal itself, [this] is not needed for the enactment of Usha, rather [it is needed] according to Reish Lakish; and according to Reish Lakish, [the Gemara] concludes it in the chapter [entitled] HaḤovel (Bava Kamma 88b and there [in the parallel passages]). Alternatively, even according to Rabbi Yoḥanan it is also needed, such as [where a husband] gives a gift to his wife, where she acquired it and the husband does not consume [its] produce; or else, where he wrote to her: "I have no claim or right in the produce of your property." However, one cannot say [that it refers to a case] where he wrote to her: "I have no claim or right in your property or in their produce," for we learned in a Mishnah in the chapter [entitled] HaKotev (below, Ketubot 83a) that if she sold or gave [it] away, [her transaction] is valid.

Tosafot on Ketubot 50a:1:1.hebrew: עשיתינהו בעי - האי עשוי צריך לומר דהיינו בדברים, כי ההוא דלקמן (כתובות דף נג.): "מעלאי דידי היינו עשוי". והשתא אתי שפיר דאמר "עשיתינהו בעי" — דאם מן הדין היה, מה היה לו לעשותם בדברים? היה לו להלקותם ולכופם עד שיזונו אותו. וכן פר"ת. ומיהו מצינו עשוי שלא בדברים, כגון: "אין מעשין אלא לפסולות" (לקמן כתובות דף עז.):
Tosafot on Ketubot 50a:1:1.english: Did he need to force them? - Regarding this "forcing," one must say that it means through words [i.e., verbal persuasion], like that [statement] below (Ketubot 53a): "My entering [to persuade] is my forcing." And now it works out well that [the Gemara] says, "Did he need to force them?" — for if it were [obligatory] by law, why would he need to force them through words? He should have flogged them and compelled them [by force] until they fed him. And so Rabbeinu Tam explained. However, we [also] find [the term] "forcing" [used] not through words, such as [in the Mishnah]: "We only compel [a husband to divorce] for disqualified [wives]" (below, Ketubot 77a).

Tosafot on Ketubot 50a:2:1.hebrew: אל יבזבז יותר מחומש - מפרש בירושלמי שפעם ראשונה יכול לבזבז חומש, ומכאן ואילך בכל שנה ושנה יתן חומש הריוח:
Tosafot on Ketubot 50a:2:1.english: "[One] should not dispense more than one-fifth" - [It] explains in the Yerushalmi that the first time one may dispense one-fifth [of his principal], and from then on, each and every year, he should give one-fifth of the profit.

Tosafot on Ketubot 50a:6:1.hebrew: שיהא אדם מגלגל עם בנו עד י"ב שנה - והא דתנן במסכת אבות (פ"ה): "בן עשר למשנה", לא שירד עמו לחייו, אלא לגלגל:
Tosafot on Ketubot 50a:6:1.english: "That a person should treat his son gently until twelve years [of age]" - And that which we learned in a Mishnah in Tractate Avot (Chapter 5): "At ten [years old one begins] Mishnah" — [this does] not [mean] that he should harass him in his life, but rather to treat [him] gently.

Tosafot on Ketubot 50a:6:2.hebrew: וספי ליה כי תורא - ולא ירד עמו לחייו עד י"ב שנה. והא דתנן במסכת אבות: "בן חמש שנים למקרא" — היינו לגלגל, ולא למיספי ליה:
Tosafot on Ketubot 50a:6:2.english: And stuff him like an ox - Yet he should not harass him in his life until twelve years [of age]. And that which we learned in the Mishnah in Tractate Avot: "At five years old, for Scripture" — that means to treat [him] gently, and not to stuff him.

Tosafot on Ketubot 50a:8:1.hebrew: בר שית למקרא - היינו בר שית ויום אחד, דומיא דבר עשר למשנה, דהוי בר עשר ויום אחד, כי ההוא דמסכת אבות; דהתם הוי בר עשר ויום אחד, דומיא דבן י"ג למצות. והשתא, האי "בר שית למקרא" לא הוי דומיא ד"בן עשר למשנה": דבר שית למקרא היינו למיספי ליה כי תורא, ובר עשר למשנה — לא למיספי ליה, אלא לגלגל עד י"ב שנה:
Tosafot on Ketubot 50a:8:1.english: A six-year-old for Scripture - This means six years and one day old, similar to "a ten-year-old for Mishnah," which means ten years and one day old, like that [teaching] in Tractate Avot; for there [too], it means ten years and one day old, similar to "thirteen years old for commandments." Now, this [statement], "a six-year-old for Scripture," is not [entirely] similar to "a ten-year-old for Mishnah": for "a six-year-old for Scripture" means to stuff him [with learning] like an ox, whereas "a ten-year-old for Mishnah" does not mean to stuff him, but rather to be patient [with him] until twelve years [of age].

Tosafot on Ketubot 50a:8:2.hebrew: ובת תריסר לתעניתא - פירש בקונטרס שנת י"ב, ומשום חינוך. ולר"י נראה דבת י"ב שנה ויום אחד קאמר, דומיא דבר עשר, כדפרישית; ואשמעינן דלית לן השלמה דרבנן, כר"י בפרק בתרא דיומא (דף פב.). והא דפי' נמי בקונט' בתינוקת "שהיא ממהרת להביא כח" — לא היה צריך לפרש כן, אלא שחינוך שלה שנה לפני גדלותה, דהיינו י"ב שנה ויום אחד, כמו תינוק שחינוכו שנה לפני גדלותו:
Tosafot on Ketubot 50a:8:2.english: And a girl of twelve for fasting - Rashi explained [this as referring to] the twelfth year, and because of training. And to Ri [Rabbeinu Yitzchak], it appears that [Abaye] is speaking of a girl [who is] twelve years and one day [old], similar to "a ten-year-old," as I explained [above]; and [Abaye] teaches us that we do not have rabbinic completion [of a full-day fast], in accordance with Rabbi Yochanan in the last chapter of Yoma (82a). And also that which Rashi explained regarding a girl, "that she is quick to gain strength" — he did not need to explain it thus; rather, [it is simply] that her training is a year before her majority, that is, twelve years and one day, just like a boy whose training is a year before his majority:

Tosafot on Ketubot 50a:9:1.hebrew: ומאי אסותיה - פר"ת שלא ישכנו; אבל אין נראה לפרש לאחר שנשכו, דהא אמר דלא חיי — משמע דאין רפואה מועלת לו:
Tosafot on Ketubot 50a:9:1.english: "And what is his cure" - Rabbeinu Tam explained [that this remedy is administered beforehand] so that [the creature] will not bite him; however, it does not appear [correct] to explain [that it is applied] after it has bitten him, for [the Gemara] stated that he will not live, [which] implies that no remedy is effective for him.
